Panchayat Season 5 Release Delayed, Fan Theories Abound

Fans of the series 'Panchayat' are speculating about the plot of the upcoming fifth season, with theories circulating about who attacked Pradhan ji, whether the character Abhishek will leave, the guilt of Banrakas, and the fate of Rinki. The release of Panchayat Season 5 is not expected in 2026.
